1. Experiment Information

2. Start & End Date

Start Date: [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

End / Report Date: [[REPORT_DATE]]

3. Methods

3.1 Automated Workflow Overview
  1. Manual Sample Loading
    • The system was paused with the instruction: "Manually fill sample loop".
    • The sample loop was filled manually with the chromatography sample prior to starting the automated run.
  2. ÄKTA Pure Automated Run
    • The ÄKTA Pure system executed the predefined chromatography protocol with online monitoring of UV (uv1) and conductivity (cond) signals.
    • Sample monitoring interval: [[SAMPLE_TIME_MIN]] (if applicable, replace with actual sampling time in minutes).

4. Results

4.1 Chromatogram
[[PLOT_1]]

Figure 1: Chromatogram showing UV and conductivity signals recorded during the ÄKTA Pure run. The plot file is provided via the eLabFTW download URL associated with this report.

4.2 Notes on Interpretation
  • Review peak shapes, retention times, and peak areas for product and impurity fractions.
  • Correlate UV and conductivity profiles with the programmed gradient and wash/CIP steps using the parameters listed above.
  • Document fraction collection details and pool decisions in the experiment notes if applicable.
